slots.notes: Fullscreen looping background video pinned to the bottom of the section (absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 w-full object-cover object-bottom, pointer-events-none); autoplays, muted, plays inline, with no overlay, tint, or gradient over it.

Editorial serif display face (Instrument Serif, regular + italic) loaded via Google Fonts and wired to Tailwind font-serif; carries the giant clamp(60px,11vw,160px) 'Stay in' headline line, including its italic span.

Sans body face (Manrope, weights 300/400/500/600) loaded via Google Fonts and wired to Tailwind font-sans; carries the second headline line, the descriptor paragraph, the email input, and the uppercase Subscribe button.

mechanic: A full-viewport white section with a fullscreen looping video pinned to its bottom behind a max-w-[1480px] content column, where the oversized serif/sans heading and the newsletter block each fade + rise + unblur (opacity 0->1, y 40->0, blur 20px->0) on first scroll-into-view, staggered 200ms apart.
techDelivery: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion (motion/react) component spec, with Google Fonts (Instrument Serif + Manrope) and the Tailwind fontFamily mapping declared in index.html.
reskinNotes: All copy is hardcoded in JSX, including the brand-specific 'Editions and invitations from the Bentley fragrance studio, sent twice a season.' descriptor and the 'Stay in / the collection' headline. The placeholder background-video URL is a brand-specific CloudFront asset that must be swapped per brand. Headline sizing is baked inline (serif clamp(60px,11vw,160px) and a fixed 64px sans line with -0.02em tracking), so the two lines are tuned to the native fonts' metrics and will need re-tuning if the typefaces change. The palette is pure black-on-white with rgba(0,0,0,*) opacity tokens for the body text, form divider, and placeholder, so reskinning to a light-on-dark scheme means inverting those rgba values rather than flipping a single token.
